blind.description: A stylized masonry archway featuring two sturdy square pillars with molded plinth bases and capitals, supporting a semicircular arch. The arch consists of alternating dark grey and reddish-brown voussoir blocks, crowned by a prominent projecting keystone block at the apex. The mesh is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled in a stylized low-poly art style with hand-painted edge highlights and weathered stone textures. Each pillar sits flatly and directly on the floor with no added ground slab.
blind.from_above: A symmetrical rectangular strip showing the top profile of the arch, flanked by the wider square caps of the two pillars and dominated by the flat rectangular top of the keystone in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.1 to 1.2 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6.5 to 7 feet tall), and slightly narrower than the figure's height in total width (around 4.5 to 5 feet wide).
